files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  The simple logos (model logos@1): a short heading and the logos as a list, each a picture named by the
  company. Axes: surface (plain: a wrapping row, cards: a grid on a card surface).
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { SimpleLogo } from "./logos-simple.types";

export type LogosSimpleProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  logos: SimpleLogo[];
  level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
  padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
  align?: "start" | "center" | "end";
  surface?: "plain" | "cards";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Container from "../compose/Container.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  logos,
  level = 2,
  padding = "standard",
  align = "center",
  surface = "plain",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<LogosSimpleProps>();
const titleId = computed(() => id + "-title");
const column = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "end"
  : "start"
);
const textAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "text-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "text-end"
  : "text-start"
);
const itemsAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "items-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "items-end"
  : "items-start"
);
const selfAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "self-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "self-end"
  : ""
);
const row = computed(() =>
  (surface as string) === "cards" ? "grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 md:grid-cols-4"
  : (align as string) === "center" ? "flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-8"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-8"
  : "flex flex-wrap justify-start gap-8"
);
const item = computed(() =>
  (surface as string) === "cards" ? "flex rounded bg-card p-6 border border-border"
  : "w-32"
);
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="section"
    :class="
      (padding as string) === 'compact' ? 'py-8 lg:py-16'
      : (padding as string) === 'spacious' ? 'py-24 lg:py-40'
      : 'py-16 lg:py-32'
    "
    :aria-labelledby="(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
    data-slot="logos-simple"
  >
    <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
      <Stack gap="8" :align="column">
        <Title :as="level" size="lg" weight="semibold" :class="cn('text-muted-foreground', textAlign)" :id="titleId">
          {{ title }}
        </Title>
        <List tag="ul" :class="cn('m-0 w-full list-none p-0', row)">
          <ListItem v-for="l in logos" :key="l.id" :class="item" data-slot="logo">
            <MediaFrame :alt="l.title" :src="l.image" />
          </ListItem>
        </List>
      </Stack>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
